entries.title: Return to service without a test
entries.lesson: If a joint is disturbed, test it before service, because untested joints leak (EVD-0001).
entries.context: A pump went back to service after a seal change with no leak test on the work order.

recommendations.what: Interlock pressurisation on a signed test record
recommendations.leading_indicator: Share of restarts with a test record

recommendations.what: Add the leak test to the return-to-service checklist

entries.title: Spares bought without a specification
entries.lesson: If spares are bought without a specification, the wrong part can reach the plant (EVD-0003).
entries.context: Seals were bought locally without a specification.

recommendations.what: Hold spares against a specification in the stores system
recommendations.leading_indicator: Share of seal issues with a specification check

entries.title: Gas alarm with no shutdown
entries.lesson: If a gas alarm only displays, the response waits for a person to notice (EVD-0002).

recommendations.what: Link the gas detector to a shutdown
